purpose: Stage-2 packet-behavior representation for later representation-level fusion; not an attack detector.
investigation_and_extraction_scope: New derived artifact only; source v2 dataset and model were read-only.
model: CatBoost pipeline selected by validation macro-F1 (0.768059)
family_probability_meaning: CatBoost model-derived behavioral evidence, not ground-truth family labels. Values are class probabilities and each row sums to one.
preprocessing: Existing fitted Pipeline SimpleImputer and CatBoost model were used; no fitting occurred during extraction.
temporal_split: Per-scenario chronological 70% train, 15% validation, 15% test; no shuffle.

leakage_checks.critical_caveat: The frozen model was trained on chronological train rows; train-row probabilities are in-sample and are marked. Downstream supervised fusion must use out-of-fold train probabilities or raw packet features for train rows, and must never evaluate using in-sample prediction evidence.

limitations: Each family corresponds to one capture/scenario; probabilities may encode capture-specific behavior.
Stage-2 PCAP timelines are not automatically row-alignable with Stage-1 timelines.
